findings.text: the test file's local _git/_commit duplicate the shared git() helper in tests/helpers/git.py instead of importing it, and the local copy drops the RUN_ID_ENV strip the shared helper performs so a mutating verb survives the git shim inside a crew worker

VERDICT goal: the node goal is to withdraw a review of the head a resume replaced whether its record was written before or after the resume; reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1384 now decides by head and keeps launched reviews and reviews of the resumed head.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_resume_withdraws_the_review_of_the_replaced_head.py; gate-head-arm.log records 54 passed EXIT=0, gate-base-arm.log 51 passed EXIT=0, negative-control.log 1 failed/2 passed EXIT=1.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares the fix module, the new test, the landing fragment and a figures dir; every path in the diff is inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read; it states the gate, base, negative-control and population figures and names every log path.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against base 28595c5569; two commits, three files, all inside the declared scope.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/resumption.py:1701, reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:711, reckon/crew/recovery.py:259
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1413 removes the resumed_at <= at gate and withdraws on supersedes_head, so a review of the replaced head is withdrawn regardless of its record time.
SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-head-arm.log ends 54 passed EXIT=0 and gate-base-arm.log 51 passed EXIT=0, with evidence-head-arm.ids and evidence-base-arm.ids identical over 48 modules.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: fca6c3d08d and 3e445fce5c touch only reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, the new test and the landing fragment, all inside the manifest's declared paths.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: negative-control.log shows the record-time ordering reinstated makes test_a_review_recorded_after_the_resume_is_withdrawn fail with report is None, and the two control cases still pass.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change removes one comparison and reuses the existing supersedes_head and _review_head_covers helpers in reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:180 and :380 rather than adding a mechanism.
SCORE reuse: 5
JUSTIFICATION reuse: tests/test_a_resume_withdraws_the_review_of_the_replaced_head.py:40 duplicates the shared git() helper owned by tests/helpers/git.py instead of importing it.
FINDING tests/test_a_resume_withdraws_the_review_of_the_replaced_head.py:40 non-blocking: the local _git/_commit helpers duplicate the shared git() in tests/helpers/git.py and drop its RUN_ID_ENV strip, which the owner performs so a mutating verb survives the git shim inside a crew worker.
FINDING tests/test_a_resume_withdraws_the_review_of_the_replaced_head.py:228 non-blocking: report["review_run_id"] == review_run_id echoes the variable the fixture passed in rather than an independent source, so it holds for any passthrough.
